title: 第11章 杀手妖姬美人计第12章 灵根之体烛光晚餐
content_zh:
离开何诗韵之后，张扬没去五楼武堂，而是回到酒店。
柳飘絮一直在等着，见他回来，这才松了口气。
“你是不是不开心？”
柳飘絮开口询问。
“可能想的有点多。”
“想什么，跟我说说。”
《龙凤培元功》，需要跟女人双修，方能增进修为。
偏偏这种事情，是爱人跟恋人之间才能做的事情，一般女人又怎会随便跟男人发生关系。
张扬不可能花那么多时间在感情纠葛上，不想付出，又想得到，这就造就了眼前困境。
刚才，他完全可以先答应何诗韵，把严冰拿下再说。
但是，他做不到，心还是不够狠。
“想着赚钱。”张扬笑道。
他不想跟她说太多，省得她多想。
女人跟着享福就行了，拼搏是男人的事情。
……
半个小时之前。
乌云压城，世界恍若末日。
兰志杰咳嗽着，上了一辆豪华跑车。
一声雷鸣，大雨滂沱而下，瞬间，天地间一片黑暗。
“张扬，这笔账，老子一定会跟你算。”

兰志杰的拳头狠狠砸在方向盘上，发泄着内心愤怒。
他启动车子，准备开走，车头走过一道寂寥的倩影。
暴雨夜，大街空无一人，出现一个冒雨独行的女人，一般人都会将这类人归为有病。
如果是一名万中无一的绝色美女，那就不一样了。
她有可能是失恋，也有可能是遭遇人生重大变故，生不如死。
兰志杰打开车灯，按了一下喇叭。
女人吓得趔趄倒地，看向车头，露出一张妖魅众生的脸。
兰志杰呼吸瞬间停止。
这女人太美了！
他这辈子从未见过如此漂亮的女人，那楚楚可怜的模样，让他为自己的粗鲁而自责。
女人爬起来，继续独行，孤独的身影，让兰志杰看了心疼。
白色连体裙很薄，在暴雨冲洗下，几近透明，露出耀眼的红色内衣。
兰志杰抓起一把伞，打开车门，追了上去。
“小姐，这么大的雨，你会感冒的。”
话还没说完，白裙女子头一歪，晕倒在他怀中。
content_en:
After leaving He Shiyun, Zhang Yang did not go to the martial arts hall on the fifth floor, but returned to the hotel.
Liu Piaoxu had been waiting and was relieved when she saw him coming back.
"Are you unhappy?"
Liu Piaoxu asked.
"Maybe I'm thinking too much."
"What are you thinking about? Tell me."
"Dragon and Phoenix Pei Yuan Gong" needs to be practiced with a woman in order to improve your cultivation.
But this kind of thing is something that can only be done between lovers. How can ordinary women have casual relations with men.
It is impossible for Zhang Yang to spend so much time on emotional entanglements. He doesn't want to give but wants to get at the same time, which creates the current dilemma.
Just now, he could have agreed to He Shiyun first and captured Yan Bing first.
However, he couldn't do it because his heart was still not cruel enough.
"Thinking about making money." Zhang Yang smiled.
He didn't want to tell her too much to save her from thinking too much.
Women can just follow along and enjoy the blessings. Fighting is a man's business.
…
half an hour ago.
Dark clouds rolled over the city, and the world seemed to be ending.
Lan Zhijie coughed and got into a luxury sports car.
There was a thunder, heavy rain fell, and in an instant, darkness fell between the sky and the earth.
"Zhang Yang, I will definitely settle this account with you."
Lan Zhijie slammed his fist on the steering wheel, venting his inner anger.
He started the car and was about to drive away, when a lonely figure passed by the front of the car.
On a rainy night, when the streets are deserted and a woman walks alone in the rain, most people will classify such people as sick.
It would be different if it was a one-of-a-kind stunning beauty.
She might have fallen out of love, or she might have encountered a major change in her life, and life would be worse than death.
Lan Zhijie turned on the car lights and honked the horn.
The woman stumbled to the ground in fright and looked towards the front of the car, revealing a face that was alluring to all living beings.
Lan Zhijie's breathing stopped instantly.
This woman is so beautiful!
He had never seen such a beautiful woman in his life, and her pitiful appearance made him blame himself for his rudeness.
The woman got up and continued walking alone. Her lonely figure made Lan Zhijie feel distressed.
The white jumpsuit was so thin that it was almost transparent after being washed by the heavy rain, revealing the dazzling red underwear.
Lan Zhijie grabbed an umbrella, opened the car door, and chased after him.
"Miss, you will catch a cold due to such heavy rain."
Before he finished speaking, the woman in the white dress tilted her head and fainted in his arms.
